items.title: Walter Nelson Interview, 1960-10-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] did you ever know Piku's brother? ... [INTERVIEWEE] oh I would call him Piku

ctx.x: can you tell us anything about how when you played with Piku in the old days what the band was like? how did he play? was it a different style than now? or what do you think?

well it was different it was the same style you know but we didn't never use no band with Piku we would always get on a party you know get two guitars and get in the backyard drink beer and all that have fun I know they played in a band with them too we just have to get together with the guitar two friends of us Sunday we meet and we go in the yard and have fun
did you ever know Piku's brother? I never got to meet him the one who would sing all the creole songs yeah what was his name?
